### Consumed by Pride
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-september-14-2025.html
Passage: Esther 5:9
Points:
- Haman lived as the ultimate egomaniac, craving praise and acting as if he were the center of the universe.
- Despite his wealth, prestige, and royal favor, a single perceived slight from Mordecai completely shattered his joy.
- Pride breeds perpetual discontentment, blinding a person to blessings and stirring up bitter, destructive anger.
- In stark contrast to Haman's arrogance, Jesus demonstrated true greatness by humbling Himself to serve others.
- Recognizing the subtle pride in our own hearts should drive us to seek God's mercy and cultivate Christlike humility.
